rules.dividers: Solid, pixel-aligned 1px layers in divider (#333333), edge to edge across container padding. Command-bar separators use the same color. Pen uses filled rectangles instead of frame-edge strokes. Control borders retain input-border; focus and selection outlines retain 2px width.
rules.brandSeparator: Share the 88px minimum --page-header-height with workspace page-header title rows, aligning desktop dividers. Keep the logo at 32px.
rules.containers: Structural containers are solid. Solid form containers keep the card shadow.
rules.neutralButtons: Retain gradient; approved variants may omit shadow.
rules.text: Representative roles; approved mockups retain component-specific shade variations.
rules.unspecified: No new hover, motion, or responsive breakpoint rules approved.
rules.tabs: Horizontal section tabs are solid and attached to their content surface, with 8px top corners, square bottom corners, a 1px top and side input-border, 44px height, 20px horizontal padding, and 6px gaps. Selected fill matches the owned surface. No gradient, shadow, enclosing track, or selection underline. Segmented controls keep their separate gradient treatment. Vertical modal navigation is unchanged. Draw the strip boundary behind tab items instead of as a foreground bottom stroke on the strip frame.
rules.sectionHeaders: Page headers combine title and context on the left with search, filters, view controls, and actions on the right. Primary action last. The title row uses the shared 88px minimum --page-header-height. If the combined controls and actions cannot fit beside the title, move the whole group into a full-width second row below the title divider and allow related groups to wrap further. Size by available container width and retain 40px controls. Attached tabs follow directly below. Scoped task actions, embedded-view toolbars, canvas tools, and individual form save buttons remain local. Apply shared-pattern corrections across all matching screens.
rules.controlHeights: Standard buttons, single-line fields, selects, search inputs, and segmented controls share a 40px outer height. Segmented tracks use 4px padding and 32px-high segments. Align neighboring controls by outer bounds. Attached tabs stay 44px; the editor vertical control stack stays 32px. Navigation rows and multiline fields retain purpose-specific sizing.
rules.pageSubtitles: Optional meaningful status, scope, or behavior beneath the heading. Title-only and two-line headers share an 88px minimum height; title/subtitle gap is 4px; subtitles use 13px IBM Plex Sans, weight 400, line-height 1.4, and label-text. Keep 40px actions vertically centered. Wrapped text can grow the title row; overflowing controls and actions move below its divider. Workflow draft and publication status appear together beneath the title, without duplicate badges or tab-row labels.
rules.sidebarNavigation: Omit Recent workflows and a generic Settings destination from v2 sidebars, screen examples, and reusable sidebar masters. Dedicated settings navigation is deferred; existing feature-specific settings and editors remain in scope.

narrative.overview: Grid uses solid structural containers, recessed fields, and modest elevation for controls, workflow cards, and graph nodes. Compact typography leaves space for execution data and direct authoring.
dos: Do use solid fills for structural containers and preserve the form-container shadow.
Do extend dividers to the edges of their containing panel, across content padding.
Do preserve status text, Mantine semantics, and shared form and contract editors.
donts: Don't apply card gradients or button elevation to every container, badge, or icon tile.
Don't infer new capabilities, live metrics, responsive rules, or motion from the static mockups.
